blocks.text: דְּרוֹר לְכָל בְּרִיָּה. בְּקוֹל הַעֲבָרַת שׁוֹפָר: הָכְשַׁל בְּנַאֲפוּף. בְּזָרַת גִּפּוּף. הֻצַּג בְּרִיב צָפוּף. בְּקוֹל חֶרְדַּת שׁוֹפָר: הָעֳנַשׁ בְּאַפּוּף. וְשָׁב הֱיוֹת חָפוּף. הוֹעִילוֹ לֵב כָּפוּף. בְּקוֹל כְּפִיפַת שׁוֹפָר: וְאִם שׁוֹד יַעַלְזוֹ. וּבַדִּין יְלִיזוֹ. וְצֶדֶק יָרוּץ לְאָחֲזוֹ. בְּקוֹל חִיל שׁוֹפָר: וּכְמוֹ מַכְנִים בְּזוֹ. וּמוֹצִיא בְּזוֹ. וְכֵן מֶנּוּ יְגִיזוֹ. בְּקוֹל רוּחַ שׁוֹפָר: זֶה מִכָּל קוֹלוֹת. אֲשֶׁר בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת. זִקֵּק לִקְהִלּוֹת. קוֹל תֵּקַע שֹׁפָר: זְמַמֵי עֲקַלְקַלֹּת. מְחֻיְּבֵי סְקִילוֹת. זָעוּ בְּגִדּוּעַ מַקְלוֹת. בְּקוֹל שֵׁמַע שׁוֹפָר: חַי מִכָּל שָׁנָה. יוֹם זֶה שִׁנָּה. חָקוּק לְשׁוֹשַׁנָּה. לְקוֹל חֵרוּת שׁוֹפָר: חִבָּתוֹ מִשְׁנֶה. שְׁנִיָּה

blocks.text: שְׂעִירוֹת. הוֹגֶה בְּתַחֲנוּנִים. כִּי לְךָ הַקּוֹל: הוֹשַׁע. אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשָּׁכַח עֵדוּת. וּמִפִּי זַרְעוֹ. לֹא יָסוּף קוֹל: וְחוֹזַי וּמְלִיצַי. הֵם בְּנֵי אִמִּי. וְאָז נִחֲרוּ בִי. לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמַע קוֹל: וְעַל מִשְׁמַרְתָּם. יַעַמְדוּ וְיִזְעָקוּ. וְגַל לָהֶם סוֹד. וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם בְּקוֹל: זֶה חָמַק מֶנִּי. אֲסוֹבֵב וַאֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ. בְּכָל מָקוֹם הוּא. אָנָה אֶשָּׂא קוֹל: זֵכֶר דּוֹדִי לְמַטָּה. אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם. מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ. לְמַעְלָה קוֹרְאִים בְּקוֹל: חֲיָלֵי מַיִם. אֲשֶׁר בָּם שְׁבִילוֹ. דִּבְּרוּ תְּמוּנָה לֹא רָאִינוּ. זוּלָתִי קוֹל: חִפַּשְׂתִּי יְשִׁימוֹן הֲיֵשׁ. וְאָמְרוּ אָיִן. קֶדֶם תִּתּוֹ עֹז. בִּעֲתַנִי בְּקוֹל: טָהוֹר דִּלֵּג. הָרִים וְעָבַר. וּמִמְּעוֹן הַר מוֹר. אָז נָתַן קוֹל: טִמֵּאתִי יְדִידוּת שִׁכְנוֹ וְעָלָה. לְיוֹם כֶּסֶא יָבֹא. בְּאָזְנַי קוֹל: יָקַרְתִּי בְּעֵינָיו.
uncertainties: Line 13: the holam on לֹא sits on an alef-lamed ligature. The same ligature appears on lines 18 and 20.
Line 14: the dagesh in בִי cannot be resolved.
Line 16: the vowel under the alef of אֲסוֹבֵב is smudged. It is probably a hataf patah, and a hataf segol cannot be fully ruled out.
Line 21: the qamats under the alef of אָיִן is visible.
Line 22: the image supports וְעָבַר (sheva, qamats, patah), not the blind reading וָעֵבֶר.

blocks.text: creature be granted through the sound of the Shofar. He who has sinned in adultery, through the embrace of the strange woman, and is led, penned up in judgment, dreads the sound of the Shofar. He who was punished in anger and repents to be purified, his bent heart avails him at the sound of the bent Shofar. If the evil impulse had tempted him and he is accused in justice, clemency hastens to hold him up at the tremulous sound of the Shofar. Just as the sound passed through the Shofar, so does the Lord cut short the speech of the accuser at the breath of the sound of the Shofar. Of all the sounds that are heard in assemblies, He has made incumbent on communities the sound of the blast of the Shofar. They who planned crooked deeds, deserving of death by stoning, trembled when the cedars broke at the report of the sound of the Shofar (on the day of the Revelation). The Eternal of every year has set apart this day from the whole year and appointed it for the Rose (Israel) for a proclamation of freedom through the sound of the Shofar. There will be extraordinary love greater than the previous love; the sin of

hands (of Esau), when he meditates on entreaties, for to Thee is his voice. Grant help that the testimony should not be forgotten and from the mouth of His seed there should be no end to his voice. My seers and my spokesmen, the sons of my mother, remonstrated with me that I should hear Thy voice. They stand on their watch and cry out; let the secret be revealed to them that the Lord may answer them with His voice. He has left me, I wander about and seek Him, He is in every place, where shall I raise my voice? The fame of my Beloved is below, He is mighty on high, ‘the whole earth is full of His glory’ do they call out above with their voice. The soldiers in the waters through which He made a path (the Sea of Reeds) said ‘we have seen no form but only a voice’. I searched for Him in the desert and they said that He is not there, yet when of old He gave His law, He frightened me with His voice. In purity He leapt over mountains and paths and from His dwelling on Mount Moriah He once sent forth His voice. When I defiled His dear dwelling, He rose up from it, on the hidden day there will come in my ears a voice. I was dear in His eyes and He adhered to me
